Name: Shardust's Dynamic Interior
Author: Shardust
TagLine: This a series of retextures of the game's Kitchen, Beds, Wood Beams/Columns/Stairs
Description:
SHARDUST'S DYNAMIC INTERIOR (FORMERLY DYNAMIC KITCHEN)

Update 4.0.0 (All-In-One file)

In this update:
1)I've further refined the kitchen textures and added 6 different kitchen decor options with an option to randomize them every day.
2)I've edited the single bed, double bed, and crib textures (vanilla, classic, modern), with 6 different patterns for the single and double bed covers, with an option to randomize them every day.
3)I've added recolor options for the wood beams, room's columns separations, and stairs inside the farmhouse, that will show for all farmhouse upgrades.


  "Kitchen1": "Classic", ------------ Change the kitchen style for the first farmhouse upgrade (vanilla, classic, modern)
  "KitchenBaseColor1": "Cocoa", ------------ Change the kitchen color for the first farmhouse upgrade (valid for all kitchen styles)
  "CounterTop1": "Wood", ------------ Select the countertop style for the first farmhouse upgrade (only when kitchen style is classic or modern)
  "CounterTopColor1": "Cream", ------------ Select the countertop color for the first farmhouse upgrade (only when kitchen style is classic or modern)
  "Appliances1": "Classic", ------------ Change the appliances style for the first farmhouse upgrade (classic, modern - only when kitchen style is classic or modern)
  "AppliancesColor1": "Rust", ------------ Change the appliances style for the first farmhouse upgrade (valid for all kitchen styles)
  "KitchenDecorStyle1": "One", ------------ Select the decor style from 6 variations for the first farmhouse upgrade (only when kitchen style is classic or modern)
  "KitchenDecorColor1": "Topaz", ------------ Select the decor color for the first farmhouse upgrade (valid for all kitchen styles)
  "RandomKitchenDecor1": "True", ------------ Every day the decor style will change between 6 variations for the first farmhouse upgrade (only when kitchen style is classic or modern)
  "Kitchen2": "Classic", ------------ Change the kitchen style for the second farmhouse upgrade (vanilla, classic, modern)
  "KitchenBaseColor2": "Cocoa", ------------ Change the kitchen color for the second farmhouse upgrade (valid for all kitchen styles)
  "CounterTop2": "Wood", ------------ Select the countertop style for the second farmhouse upgrade (only when kitchen style is classic or modern)
  "CounterTopColor2": "Cream", ------------ Select the countertop color for the second farmhouse upgrade (only when kitchen style is classic or modern)
  "Appliances2": "Classic", ------------ Change the appliances style for the second farmhouse upgrade (classic, modern - only when kitchen style is classic or modern)
  "AppliancesColor2": "Rust", ------------ Change the appliances style for the second farmhouse upgrade (valid for all kitchen styles)
  "KitchenDecorStyle2": "One", ------------ Select the decor style from 6 variations for the second farmhouse upgrade (only when kitchen style is classic or modern)
  "KitchenDecorColor2": "Topaz", ------------ Select the decor color for the second farmhouse upgrade (valid for all kitchen styles)
  "RandomKitchenDecor2": "True", ------------ Every day the decor style will change between 6 variations for the second farmhouse upgrade (only when kitchen style is classic or modern)
   "SingleBed": "Vanilla", ------------ Change the single bed style for the starter home and the children home upgrade (vanilla, classic, modern)
  "SingleBedBase": "Cocoa", ------------ Change the single bed base color for the starter home and the children home upgrade (vanilla, classic, modern)
  "SingleBedPillow": "Cream", ------------ Change the single bed pillow color for the starter home and the children home upgrade (valid for all single bed styles)
  "SingleBedCovers": "Topaz", ------------ Change the single bed covers color for the starter home and the children home upgrade (valid for all single bed styles)
  "SingleBedCoversStyle": "Two", ------------ Change the single bed covers pattern from 6 variations for the starter home and the children home upgrade (valid for all single bed styles)
  "RandomSingleBedCovers": "False", ------------ Every day the single bed covers pattern will change between 6 variations for the starter home and the children home upgrade (valid for all single bed styles)
  "DoubleBed": "Modern", ------------ Change the double bed style for the marriage home upgrade and the children home upgrade (vanilla, classic, modern)
  "DoubleBedBase": "Cocoa", ------------ Change the double bed base color for the marriage home upgrade and the children home upgrade (valid for all double bed styles)
  "DoubleBedPillow": "Cream", ------------ Change the double bed pillow color for the marriage home upgrade and the children home upgrade (valid for all double bed styles)
  "DoubleBedCovers": "Topaz", ------------ Change the double bed covers color for the marriage home upgrade and the children home upgrade (valid for all double bed styles)
  "DoubleBedCoversStyle": "Six", ------------ Change the double bed covers pattern from 6 variations for the marriage home upgrade and the children home upgrade (valid for all double bed styles)
  "RandomDoubleBedCovers": "False", ------------ Every day the double bed covers pattern will change between 6 variations for the starter home and the children home upgrade (valid for all single bed styles)
  "Crib": "Classic", ------------ Change the crib style for the children home upgrade (vanilla, classic, modern)
  "CribBase": "Cocoa", ------------ Change the crib base color for the children home upgrade (valid for all crib styles)
  "CribPillow": "Topaz", ------------ Change the crib pillow color for the children home upgrade (valid for all crib styles)
"WoodBeams": "Cocoa" ------------ Change the wood beams, wall separations, and stairs color inside the farmhouse (valid for all farmhouse upgrades)

Available colors: Amethyst, Aquamarine, Ash, Blackberry, Coal, Cocoa, Cream, Diamond, Emerald, Honey, Mahogany, Mocha, Oak, Olive, Ruby, Rust, Saffron, Sapphire, Spinel, Steel, Topaz, Umber, Walnut, Wine
